_comment: Peacock pack switches read by kubejs/server_scripts/*.js. Server-side; takes effect on /reload or restart. ladder=false disables recipe staging and place/hire gates (Blueprints still drop). sleepPercent: players (%) that must sleep to skip the night (-1 = vanilla rule untouched). capitalWall: build the stone wall around the capital on first load (/peacock wall reruns it). capitalFound: EXPERIMENTAL, off — if the world has no capital at spawn, survey gentle land and found one there; on this pack it stalls the server for over a minute (2026-10-18), so it does not run at boot unless set true (/peacock found runs it by hand). bossBarScale: size of boss bars on screen, client-side (1 = vanilla). capitalReroll: on a brand-new, never-joined world with no capital at spawn, stop the server so peacock-start.sh deletes it and starts on a new seed (at most 15 times in a row).
